items.evidence: The log shows 48 separate p1000 pick-up/drop cycles. Each takes 250 uL from its own tube (rack 10 then 7) into its own well (A1..H1, A3..H3, ... H11), and the multichannel eluate then goes column-wise to the matching elution-plate column.

Log order is beads 40 uL (lines 10-21), isopropanol 2x125 (24-47), then samples with 5 mixes (aspirate/dispense 400 uL x5), delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL removed to slot 1 per column with the magnet engaged.
Two washes of 3x166.667 uL ethanol (reservoir A9-A12) per column, each removed to waste in 3x166.667 with the magnet engaged (lines 773-943). Then delay 240 s, then disengage (944-945).

After disengaging, 100 uL elution buffer from A4 is added per column. Each column is mixed 10x at 80 uL, then delay 30 s, engage, delay 90 s, and 80 uL is moved to A1/A3/.../A11 of the elution plate on the temperature module, which was set to 4 C at log line 2.
Step order matches the paper and the task. The only addition is a harmless 3x150 uL mix of the bead stock in the reservoir, and there are no false comments or reagent mix-ups.

judge.summary: The simulated robot run follows the specified sequence for 48 samples. The volumes, tips, magnet timings, waste removal, elution and 4 °C temperature setting all match the task. The only deviation is an extra bead-stock pre-mix in the reservoir, which I judged not to be an invented step that would fail fidelity, so all five items pass.
